name: PDF Financial Extractor
tagline: Extract and normalize financial metrics from PDFs into structured tables
description: Reads 10-Ks, CIMs, pitch decks, and audited financials. Extracts key financial metrics, normalizes units and currencies, aligns time periods, and outputs a source-cited table with confidence scores.

schema.label: Financial Documents
schema.description: Drop 10-Ks, CIMs, pitch decks, or audited financials here

schema.label: Metrics to Extract
schema.description: Leave defaults or customize. If empty, all core metrics are extracted.

schema.label: Time Periods
schema.description: Optional. Specify periods to focus on, or leave blank to extract all available periods.

primary.label: Extracted Financial Metrics
primary.description: Normalized metrics table with source citations and confidence scores

secondary.label: Extraction Notes
secondary.description: Document summaries, EBITDA bridges, discrepancies, assumptions, and data quality warnings
